rules_primary: If there is at least 3 or more consecutive days within September 28, 2026 through October 4, 2026 on which the daily average temperature at KLAS in Las Vegas is strictly greater than 90 degrees Fahrenheit, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
A day's average temperature is the arithmetic mean of the hourly temperature values reported by The Weather Company for KLAS from 12:00 AM to 11:59 PM local time, rounded to the nearest whole degree.
Only days within September 28, 2026 through October 4, 2026 may count toward a streak.
Data as published at the Expiration Time will be used; later revisions are disregarded.

Doesn't count for payout
An average of exactly 90 degrees Fahrenheit does not satisfy the condition.
A day with fewer than 18 reported hourly values does not satisfy the condition and breaks a streak.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Bald Mountain (Sun Valley) conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Bald Mountain (Sun Valley).
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity. 
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion.
If Bald Mountain (Sun Valley) is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count.
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
Only Bald Mountain at Sun Valley counts.

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count.
Opening at Dollar Mountain does not count.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Bald Mountain (Sun Valley). All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Killington Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Killington Resort.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity.
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion.
If Killington Resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count.
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
Only Killington Resort counts.

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count. 
Opening at Pico Mountain does not count. 

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Killington Resort. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Killington Resort.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity.
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion.
If Killington Resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count.
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
Only Killington Resort counts.

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count. 
Opening at Pico Mountain does not count. 

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Killington Resort. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Alyeska Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Alyeska Resort.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity.
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion.
If Alyeska Resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If Keystone Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations in the 26/27 winter season before Oct 25, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on resort-designated open terrain. 
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
A name, owner, operator, or website change does not change the resort's identity.
If the ski resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Season-passholder-only access counts if it requires no additional purchase. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
If its terrain is split across separately operated areas, opening any portion counts. 

Doesn't count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Announced or projected dates do not count. 

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the resort. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Jackson Hole Mountain Resort.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if ADF&G issues its preseason total run forecast before the scheduled close time.
rules_primary: If the preseason total run forecast issued by ADF&G for Bristol Bay sockeye salmon for the 2027 season is above 55 million fish, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The relevant figure is the Bristol Bay-wide aggregate point estimate shown in the “Forecast” column on the row labeled “Total run.” The separate “Inshore Run” figure will not be used. The market also will not use the forecast range or prediction interval, escapement, harvestable-surplus figures, individual river or district forecasts, or the actual observed 2027 run.

Only ADF&G’s initial non-preliminary preseason forecast will be used. In-season estimates, postseason run reconstructions, and revisions made after expiration will not affect resolution. If ADF&G provides only a forecast range without a point estimate, the midpoint of that range will be used.

If ADF&G does not use the label “Total run,” the functionally equivalent Bristol Bay-wide figure, "projected total catch plus projected total escapement", will be used.
title: 2027 sockeye run forecast: above 55 million fish?

rules_primary: If any span of 4 consecutive calendar days after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2029 contains at least 2 days where the Station Average at Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) and George Bush Intercontinental Airport, Houston (IAH) is below 20°F, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
A "Qualifying Day" is a calendar day after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2029 for which the applicable Station Test is met. The Station Test is whether the Station Average for the calendar day is below 20.

A calendar day is after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2029 if the calendar date of that day, as used in the Source Agency's climatological records for the Reference Stations, falls after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2029. 

The Qualifying Days within that span need not be consecutive, and Qualifying Days occurring outside that span do not affect the determination.

The Station Average is calculated for any calendar day as the arithmetic mean of the Daily Minimum Temperatures for all Reference Stations for that calendar day, computed in degrees Fahrenheit and truncated to one decimal place.

The Daily Minimum Temperature is the minimum temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit (unless otherwise specified), for a Reference Station for a calendar day, as documented by the Source Agency in its daily or monthly climatological records for that station, using the calendar-day boundaries applied by the Source Agency in those records. If the Source Agency corrects a documented value prior to Expiration, the corrected value shall be used.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If Stowe Mountain Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations in the 26/27 winter season before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on resort-designated open terrain. 
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
A name, owner, operator, or website change does not change the resort's identity.
If the ski resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Season-passholder-only access counts if it requires no additional purchase. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
If its terrain is split across separately operated areas, opening any portion counts. 

Doesn't count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Announced or projected dates do not count. 

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the resort. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If Beaver Creek Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations in the 26/27 winter season before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on resort-designated open terrain. 
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
A name, owner, operator, or website change does not change the resort's identity.
If the ski resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Season-passholder-only access counts if it requires no additional purchase. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
If its terrain is split across separately operated areas, opening any portion counts. 

Doesn't count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Announced or projected dates do not count. 

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the resort. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If Heavenly Mountain Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations in the 26/27 winter season before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on resort-designated open terrain. 
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
A name, owner, operator, or website change does not change the resort's identity.
If the ski resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Season-passholder-only access counts if it requires no additional purchase. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
If its terrain is split across separately operated areas, opening any portion counts. 

Doesn't count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Announced or projected dates do not count. 

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the resort. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Aspen Mountain conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Aspen Mountain.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity. 
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion.
If Aspen Mountain is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
Only Aspen Mountain counts.

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count. 
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count. 
Openings at Aspen Highlands, Buttermilk, and Snowmass do not count. 

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Aspen Mountain. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

rules_secondary:
The official observing station is Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport (station identifier KCVG, WMO identifier 72421). The specified local timezone is America/New_York. The accumulation period includes Oct 1, 2026 through Dec 31, 2026.

A Heating Degree Day (HDD) value measures how far a day's average temperature falls below 65°F. For each local calendar day, HDD equals 65 minus the daily average temperature in Fahrenheit, floored at zero. Days averaging 65°F or warmer contribute zero HDD; the excess above 65°F is not counted and does not offset colder days. For example, a day averaging 40°F contributes 25.00 HDD, and a day averaging 72°F contributes 0.00 HDD, not -7.00. The daily value is the HDD (65) figure published by The Weather Company for the station; if that figure is not published, it is calculated from The Weather Company's "Hourly Mean(F)" value, which is the arithmetic mean of the hourly temperatures reported for that day. The cumulative sum is the total of these daily values across every day in the specified time period.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If Northstar California Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations in the 26/27 winter season before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on resort-designated open terrain. 
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
A name, owner, operator, or website change does not change the resort's identity.
If the ski resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Season-passholder-only access counts if it requires no additional purchase. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
If its terrain is split across separately operated areas, opening any portion counts.

rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Mt. Bachelor conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Dec 27, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Mt. Bachelor.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date. 
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity. 
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion. 
If Mt. Bachelor is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Alta Ski Area conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing on terrain designated open for that use by Alta Ski Area.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity. 
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion.
If Alta Ski Area is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count.
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
Only Alta Ski Area counts. Alta permits skiing only, and snowboarding is not required. 

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count. 
Opening at Snowbird does not count, including on interconnected terrain or a joint pass.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Alta Ski Area. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.
title: Will Alta open before Nov 29, 2026?

rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Alta Ski Area conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Nov 22, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing on terrain designated open for that use by Alta Ski Area.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity. 
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion.
If Alta Ski Area is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count.
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
Only Alta Ski Area counts. Alta permits skiing only, and snowboarding is not required. 

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count. 
Opening at Snowbird does not count, including on interconnected terrain or a joint pass.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Alta Ski Area. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Snowbird Ski Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Snowbird Ski Resort.
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity.
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion.
If Snowbird Ski Resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Snowbird Ski Resort. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Seasonal Opening Operations occur before the specified date or if the Source Agency reports that the ski resort will not open during the season.
rules_primary: If the first calendar day in the 2026-27 winter season on which Snowbasin Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations occurs before Nov 29, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on terrain designated open for that use by Snowbasin Resort. 
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
The season runs from September 1 through August 31 of the following year. “Before” excludes the specified date.
A name, branding, ownership, operator, or website change does not change the resort’s geographic identity.
If no Source Agency has documented Seasonal Opening Operations by expiration and there is insufficient information to determine their occurrence, the market resolves to last fair price, as determined by the Exchange in its sole discretion.
If Snowbasin Resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Access counts only when holders of a season pass valid for the specified season can use those lifts and terrain without an additional purchase.
Free reservations and passholder-only days count.
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count. 

Doesn’t count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Scheduled, projected, or announced opening dates do not count. 

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Snowbasin Resort. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.
